content: NUB1 (NEDD8 ultimate buster 1) is a protein in humans that is encoded by the NUB1 gene. NUB1 interacts with and negatively regulates NEDD8, which is a ubiquitin-like protein. NEDD8 covalently conjugates to members of the cullin protein family. NUB1 has been demonstrated to interact with NEDD8, UBD (ubiquitin D), and AIPL1 (aryl hydrocarbon receptor-interacting protein-like 1).
